map.计算离散信源的信息熵（平均信息量）。: Compute Shannon entropy H (bits/symbol) from discrete source symbol probabilities (probabilities should sum to 1; zero-probability terms count as 0).
map.概率应之和为 1；某事件概率为 0 时该项记 0。: Probabilities should sum to 1; a zero-probability event contributes 0.
map.压缩下限：熵即无损压缩平均码长的理论下限。: Compression limit: Entropy is the theoretical lower bound on average code length for lossless compression.

map.密码学强度：密钥/ nonce 的熵衡量抗猜测能力。: Cryptographic strength: The entropy of keys/nonces measures resistance to guessing.
map.p=0.5/0.5 → H=−2×0.5·log2(0.5)=1 bit/符号；: p=0.5/0.5 -> H = -2x0.5*log2(0.5) = 1 bit/symbol; less bias means lower entropy.
map.是，离散信源概率归一；若输入频率会自动归一化。: Yes; discrete-source probabilities are normalized, and input frequencies are auto-normalized.
map.按极限 0·log(0)=0 计入，不贡献熵。: By the limit 0*log(0)=0, they add nothing to entropy.
map.压缩场景高熵意味着难压缩；安全场景高熵（密钥）是好事。: In compression, high entropy means hard to compress; in security, high entropy (keys) is good.
